# Goal: Coverage Judge Module (standalone, hermetic + label-verified)

**Date:** 2026-08-03
**Target repo:** voice-tutor (`~/development/voice-tutor`)
**Type:** self-contained new module — harness lane (no live-code changes, no app wiring)
**Design doc:** `~/second-brain/products/voice-tutor/planning/2026-08-02-live-coverage-design.md`
**Eval set:** `~/second-brain/products/voice-tutor/validation/coverage-experiment/labels.json`

## What to build

A standalone Python module `coverage_judge.py` (plus tests) that judges claim coverage for one study session:

- **Input:** a claim list (id + claim text), an indexed transcript (list of `{index, role, content}` turns), and config (model, judge-prompt version).
- **Output:** a verdict object — for every claim id exactly once: `{claim_id, covered: bool, turns: [int, ...]}` — plus metadata: `judged_at`, `model`, `judge_prompt_hash`.
- One model call per invocation (Haiku, temperature 0), strict-JSON response parsing with the transport-layer defenses this repo has learned the hard way: markdown-fence stripping, truncation detection (verdict count must equal claim count), and a bounded retry on malformed output.
- A pure function `union_coverage(verdict_sets) -> {covered_ids, percentage}` that merges verdicts across sessions per the design doc (union by claim id, percentage derived at read time).
- A small CLI: `python -m coverage_judge --claims <file> --transcript <file> --out <file>` so the module is runnable standalone before any app wiring exists.

## The judge prompt is part of the deliverable — v2, not v1

Start from `judge-prompt-v1.md` in the eval-set folder (hash `632b73a34b1a22b1`). v1 is strict against topic adjacency but has ONE PROVEN FAILURE: it credits *fluent wrongness* — an explanation that matches a claim's shape and keywords while contradicting its specific content (see the c30 note in labels.json: the tutor taught the doc's sub-example triad as the headline three-way split, and v1 credited it).

**v2 must add a content-match requirement:** covered means the tutor's explanation is *consistent with the claim's specific assertions* — same substance, not merely same shape, topic, or shared keywords. An explanation that substitutes different specifics (different list members, different mechanism, contradicting details) is NOT covered even if fluent and adjacent.

Record the v2 prompt in the module (versioned, hashed the same way) so every verdict carries `judge_prompt_hash`.

## Verification (contract acceptance criteria)

Two layers, per this repo's learned rules:

**1. Hermetic tests (no network):** input validation, JSON parsing defenses (fenced output, truncated verdict lists, missing claim ids), union logic, CLI wiring, deterministic prompt-hash computation. Mock the model call.

**2. Credentialed smoke against the eval set (REQUIRED — this is the acceptance bar, not an afterthought):**
Run the real judge (real Haiku call, key from the repo `.env` — never echo it) against the frozen fixtures and require **label agreement**:

- Fixtures: the four PRIMARY transcripts + the matt doc's 63-claim list, and the strictness-test transcript + the shared doc's 71-claim list. Copy them into the module's test fixtures from:
  - transcripts: `~/.voice-tutor/transcripts/matt/` (sessions f6148c26, 7beee170, d33800bf, bb979045, 12f3a30d)
  - claim maps: the two docs' `.claims.json` sidecars
- **Pass criteria against `labels.json`:**
  - The 16 upheld claims (c1,c2,c3,c5,c6,c8,c9,c15,c17,c21,c27,c28,c31,c46,c47,c48) must come back covered in the union of the four primary sessions.
  - **c30 must come back NOT covered** — this is the mandatory regression case; v1 fails it, v2 must not.
  - Strictness test: session 12f3a30d against the 71-claim map must produce ≤ 2 covered claims (v1 produced exactly 1; small headroom allowed, but crediting a handful means the strictness regressed).
- If v2 prompt changes flip any of the 16 upheld labels to not-covered, that is a FAILURE of this run's criteria (do not silently trade recall for the c30 fix). Iterate the prompt until all 17 labels agree.

## Constraints

- New files only. Do not modify `bot.py`, the server, prompts, or any live path. App wiring is a separate, later CC-session task.
- Module lives in the repo (suggested: `coverage/` package or alongside existing standalone tools — follow the repo's existing module conventions).
- Costs: each credentialed smoke run is ~5 Haiku calls (~$0.07). Bound smoke invocations sensibly (don't re-run per hermetic test).
- Respect the ledger pattern if trivially available, but do NOT wire ledger writes into the app — a `--cost-out` JSON from the CLI is sufficient for now.
- Runs on Matt's Claude subscription — normal harness usage limits apply.

## Out of scope (explicitly)

- The live in-session judge loop, sidecar writes into `~/.voice-tutor`, UI/polling, topics rollup, teardown integration — all later CC work per the design doc.
- Any change to claim extraction or the claim maps.
- Re-judging or modifying `labels.json` — it is the frozen answer key. If the generated judge repeatedly fails on one specific label and the disagreement looks principled, STOP and surface it in the run report rather than tuning the prompt to force agreement.

## Success looks like

`coverage_judge.py` + tests merged on a branch, hermetic suite green, credentialed smoke green with 17/17 label agreement (16 covered + c30 not-covered) and strictness ≤ 2 on the trap session, v2 prompt versioned and hashed, CLI runnable end to end. Ready for a CC session to wire into the app.


---

## Operator launch notes (added at launch time — NOT part of the frozen goal doc above)

These are environment/wiring facts the contract negotiation MUST respect. They do not
change the goal's acceptance bar above; they make it satisfiable inside a harness worktree.

**Credentialed-smoke .env loading (CRITICAL).** The credentialed smoke needs
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. The app's `.env` is gitignored, so it does NOT exist inside the
harness worktree. The smoke must obtain the key from the process environment, or read the
app's `.env` by ABSOLUTE path `/Users/mattli/development/voice-tutor/.env` (equivalently
`$HOME/development/voice-tutor/.env`). NEVER assume a worktree-relative `./.env` — there is
none. Never echo, log, or commit the key value.

**Verifier command (hermetic layer).** The deterministic verifier runs:
`uv run --with pytest pytest tests/test_coverage_judge.py -q`
Put ALL hermetic (offline, model-call-mocked) tests in the single file
`tests/test_coverage_judge.py` so this command exercises them. The hermetic suite must make
NO network/LLM calls. The credentialed smoke is a SEPARATE, bounded step — run ONCE as
acceptance evidence (~5 Haiku calls total, ~$0.07), NOT part of the per-iteration verifier
command and NOT re-run per hermetic test.

**Resolved absolute fixture source paths** (copy these into the module's test fixtures;
UUIDs resolved at launch time):

  - 7beee170 → /Users/mattli/.voice-tutor/transcripts/matt/7beee170-47d1-418d-b35d-5cc56babaccc.json
  - d33800bf → /Users/mattli/.voice-tutor/transcripts/matt/d33800bf-9322-4c97-9153-c9f356c42b24.json
  - bb979045 → /Users/mattli/.voice-tutor/transcripts/matt/bb979045-72f5-4f84-8d8c-ae4bf137e711.json
  - 12f3a30d (STRICTNESS TEST, judged vs the 71-claim shared doc) → /Users/mattli/.voice-tutor/transcripts/matt/12f3a30d-1324-4e94-bedf-e2d3fcb18d9f.json
- Claim maps (`.claims.json` sidecars):
  - 63-claim matt doc (doc_key matt/2aa66acc) → /Users/mattli/.voice-tutor/documents/matt/2aa66acc-1c4b-4d7d-83fe-b361fbe38523.claims.json
  - 71-claim shared doc → /Users/mattli/.voice-tutor/documents/_shared/ac4b826f-b189-442e-98c0-a59bb066d600.claims.json
- Eval set (frozen answer key + v1 prompt), in
  `/Users/mattli/second-brain/products/voice-tutor/validation/coverage-experiment/`:

**Live-code guardrail.** New files only. Do NOT modify `bot.py`, the server, existing
prompts, `labels.json`, or any live path. `labels.json` is the frozen answer key.
title: coverage judge module

sprints.title: core data contract + parsing defenses
sprints.description: Establish the standalone module skeleton (new files only, follow repo module conventions; suggested coverage/ package with coverage_judge.py + tests/test_coverage_judge.py). Implement the input contract: load a claim list (id + text) and an indexed transcript (list of {index, role, content}); validate shapes and surface clear errors on malformed input. Implement the strict-JSON response parser with this repo's hard-won transport defenses as PURE, model-independent functions: markdown-fence stripping, truncation/completeness detection (parsed verdict count must equal claim count), missing/duplicate claim-id detection, and the verdict object shape {claim_id, covered: bool, turns: [int]}. Ship hermetic tests in tests/test_coverage_judge.py covering input validation, fenced output, truncated verdict lists, and missing/extra claim ids. No model call yet — these are the offline foundations everything else builds on. Verifier: uv run --with pytest pytest tests/test_coverage_judge.py -q must pass with no network.

sprints.title: v2 judge prompt (versioned + hashed)
sprints.description: Author the v2 judge prompt as a versioned, in-module artifact starting from judge-prompt-v1.md (repo hash 632b73a34b1a22b1). Reproduce the repo's exact hashing scheme so judge_prompt_hash is deterministic and matches how v1 was hashed (validate by hashing v1's text and asserting it equals 632b73a34b1a22b1 in a hermetic test — this proves the hash function is correct before trusting v2's hash). v2 adds the content-match requirement over v1: 'covered' means the tutor's explanation is consistent with the claim's SPECIFIC assertions (same substance, not merely same shape/topic/keywords); an explanation substituting different list members, a different mechanism, or contradicting specifics is NOT covered even if fluent and adjacent — directly targeting the c30 fluent-wrongness failure. Hermetic tests: deterministic prompt-hash computation, v1-hash reproduction check, and that the module exposes the versioned prompt + its hash for embedding in every verdict's metadata.

sprints.title: single-invocation judge + verdict assembly
sprints.description: Wire the parsing defenses and v2 prompt into one judge invocation: one model call per invocation (Haiku, temperature 0), producing a verdict object that contains exactly one entry per claim id plus metadata {judged_at, model, judge_prompt_hash}. Implement the bounded retry on malformed output (single retry when the parser rejects the response for truncation/shape/id-set mismatch). The model client must be injectable/mockable so hermetic tests never hit the network. Hermetic tests (mocked model): happy-path verdict assembly with correct metadata, retry-then-succeed on a first malformed response, hard-fail after retry exhausted, and exactly-one-verdict-per-claim invariant. All in tests/test_coverage_judge.py.

sprints.title: union coverage + standalone CLI
sprints.description: Implement the pure function union_coverage(verdict_sets) -> {covered_ids, percentage}: merge verdicts across sessions by union over claim ids, with percentage derived at read time per the design doc (a claim is covered if covered in ANY session). Build the CLI: python -m coverage_judge --claims <file> --transcript <file> --out <file>, plus a --cost-out JSON emitting per-run cost (ledger pattern only if trivially available; do NOT wire ledger writes into the app). Hermetic tests: union merge logic (single/multi-session, overlapping and disjoint covered sets, percentage math, empty inputs), and CLI wiring end-to-end with a mocked model call (reads claim/transcript files, writes verdict + cost JSON, correct exit behavior).

sprints.title: credentialed smoke: 17/17 label agreement
sprints.description: Copy the frozen fixtures into the module's test fixtures (new files) from the resolved absolute paths: the five transcripts (f6148c26, 7beee170, d33800bf, bb979045 as PRIMARY union set; 12f3a30d as strictness test), the 63-claim matt doc .claims.json and 71-claim shared doc .claims.json, plus labels.json (READ ONLY) and judge-prompt-v1.md. Build a SEPARATE, bounded credentialed-smoke runner (NOT part of the hermetic verifier command, run ONCE, ~5 Haiku calls / ~$0.07) that obtains ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the process environment or the app .env by ABSOLUTE path /Users/mattli/development/voice-tutor/.env (never worktree-relative, never echoed/logged/committed). Acceptance bar: the 16 upheld claims (c1,c2,c3,c5,c6,c8,c9,c15,c17,c21,c27,c28,c31,c46,c47,c48) covered in the union of the four primary sessions; c30 NOT covered (mandatory v1-regression case); strictness session 12f3a30d vs the 71-claim map yields <=2 covered. Iterate the v2 prompt until all 17 labels agree WITHOUT flipping any of the 16 upheld to not-covered. If one label repeatedly disagrees and the disagreement looks principled, STOP and surface it in the run report rather than tuning to force agreement — do NOT modify labels.json. Deliver the smoke result as acceptance evidence.
